# Generated files

| File or directory | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `compose.yaml` | Application and service topology |
| `.env` | Runtime values and service connection values |
| `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json` | VS Code Dev Container configuration, when requested |
| `docker/` | Editable runtime and database files, after `publish` |

Review changes after running `install` or `add`, especially when a project already contains a Compose file.
